description: Dark-luxury general presentation template: deep chocolate brown, espresso panels, warm cream type, one muted brass accent; refined Georgia serif headlines with brass italic accents, clean sans body, thin brass hairlines, numbered chapters, arch and rectangular image frames, and a pure-SVG visual-moment slide. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
